newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-INSURANCE POLICY TO COVER BARCELONA PLAYERS' BONSUES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INSURANCE POLICY TO COVER BARCELONA PLAYERS' BONSUES.

text.p: Barcelona soccer club has announced an agreement with a British reinsurance company to cover multi-million peseta players' win bonuses.
Under the policy the club will pay 50 percent of the total amount of the bonuses as a premium but will be entitled to a refund if Barcelona fail to win any of the three titles at stake.

Press reports suggest that winning the domestic league and cup and European Cup Winners' Cup would earn Barcelona first team players 800 million pesetas ($6.34 million). The club has refused to discuss how much money is involved.
